info.title: Math formula rendering
info.description: The RESTBase math endpoints, served by MathSearch. A formula is checked once, which returns its content address in x-resource-location, and every representation is then fetched by that address. Addresses are the same ones wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1 issues.

servers.description: This wiki. Try it out sends requests to rest.php on this host, so an address minted by check here resolves here.

post.summary: Check and normalize a TeX formula.
post.description: Checks the supplied TeX formula for correctness and returns the normalised formula representation as well as information about identifiers. The response contains the `x-resource-location` header, whose value is the formula's content address: append it to `/math/v0/render/{format}/` and issue a GET to obtain a rendering.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The input type of the given formula; can be tex, inline-tex or chem

x-resource-location.description: The content address to render the formula by

get.description: Returns the formula previously stored via `/math/v0/check/{type}` for the given content address.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: The content address returned by a check request

200.description: The formula the address stands for

404.description: No formula is known for that address

get.summary: Get a rendered formula in the given format.
get.description: Renders the formula the address stands for. Obtain the address from the `x-resource-location` header of a check request.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: The content address returned by a check request

404.description: Unknown format, or no formula is known for that address
